svg.title: DS3231 RTC module
svg.desc: Editable top view of a blue DS3231 real-time clock module, with DS3231 RTC IC, AT24C32 EEPROM, power LED, resistors, capacitors, diode, resistor arrays, address jumpers, silkscreen and four mounting holes. Six female sockets at left: 32K, SQW, SCL, SDA, VCC, GND. Four plated expansion holes at right: SCL, SDA, VCC, GND.
